programs.description: A young, simple village man looking to start a business and earn a name for himself is encouraged and supported by his grandmother to achieve his dream.
Chasing the magic of his mother's stories, a boy journeys to find a fabled island where glowing fireflies grant miracles. He braves the unknown to honor a final vow to her.
Nisha faces unimaginable pain as an orphan suffering from skin cancer. Though at peace with her reality, she discovers a glimmer of hope when she meets a young hospital worker named Suraj.
Betrayal fuels a groom's frantic search for his bride's secrets. Meanwhile, restless guests linger as he unearths her hidden history.
A father and son try to rebuild their divorce-wracked relationship by embarking on a summer-long, 4,000-mile adventure across America on bicycles with no previous experience.
Rani and Animesh, a couple who is having an affair with Jimmy plan to meet him on Saturday. The story unfolds as their meeting with Jimmy doesn't go as planned.
A poor single mother struggles fiercely to earn the extra money needed to fulfill her child's simple wish for a cake just like the one he saw in a shop.
CEO Sanjay, who is unhappy despite his wealth, hosts Oberoi Industries' success party. He invites his girlfriend Priyanka, a model, promising to make her the company's face.
Through her daughter's gentle urging, a mother rediscovers her forgotten artistic passion, escaping the monotony of her routine.

A late night conversation between a mother (Sarla) & her son Anshuman, 13 days after the passing of his father where they discuss the reasons for his detachment from his father and how by the end of the night, certain events lead Anshuman to accept and make amends with his deceased father.
In the heart of Uttarakhand, an elderly woman and a young man navigate the divide between heritage and progress. As a local festival begins, they must decide the future of their traditions.
A boy in need of money to make it big in life and a girl who is looking for thrill concoct a plan and stage a kidnapping to extort money from the girl's rich father.
A writer who is struggling with writer's block is in search of a story. However, he lands himself in trouble when he stumbles upon a deadly secret while talking to his garbage collector.

One day he finds something and with the help of his friend, tries to fulfill his dream. But, fate has a different game. The world of the 'Haves' and their desire for the little things in life that eludes them and the desires invoked by Screen, which teaches us to salivate over things we never knew otherwise existed. Sometimes small things matter the most.
A short film signifying how the energies we invite into our house affect us.
Fate plays a twisted game with Harshit and Rahila, who are madly in love with each other.
Nature photographer Shivoham travels to five locations to capture breathtaking landscapes. During his journey, unique interactions reveal deep emotions and secrets that rejuvenate him.

Hearts Awash in Sapphire Light unfolds the tale of two individuals who encounter each other one evening, initially under less-than-ideal circumstances. At first, they engage in petty arguments over trivial matters. However, as time passes, the undeniable power of their connection becomes evident, serving as a poignant reminder that sometimes, the most extraordinary journeys take place within the depths of our own hearts.

Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend's marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother's emotional journey of her son's death.
Despite different social classes, Charu and Makrand find unexpected common ground, as their growing connection reveals shared struggles and emotions.
The true colours of public officials are revealed when the lens is focused beyond their scope of duty and instead on the selfish motivations for their insincere actions.

Dhruv and Vidya get in touch and decide to meet each other a few years after their breakup. However, their meeting soon takes an unfortunate turn as old conflicts and emotions gradually come to the surface, causing them to get into a heated argument.
A mother fights for her transgender son's future and freedom, striving for acceptance and harmony from her family and society.
A young couple on their first date with the excitement of their first kiss does not find a private moment in the crowded city of Mumbai.
Khusboo suffers from a socially taboo medical condition leading to a presentation blunder. Subsequently, she finds the courage to regain her confidence and fight the anathema.
The abduction of a young girl by a serial killer takes an unforeseen turn as revelations emerge, challenging initial assumptions about the case.

During a seemingly pleasant date with Aditya, arranged by her friends, Nisha hears a concerning noise from the washroom. She discovers Aditya unconscious on the floor and immediately calls her friend Priya for help. Surprisingly, Priya dismisses Nisha's concerns, suggesting it's all imaginary. This unexpected response casts doubt on Aditya's existence and the reality of the entire situation, leaving Nisha confused about what's real and what might be a product of her imagination.

A modest family from Haryana relocated to Dhanbad, Bihar, and took up residence in a government quarter that had previously been inhabited by the notorious Loha Chor gang during the 1980s in Bihar. The family encountered numerous challenges and social difficulties from both the local neighbourhood inhabitants and the remnants of the Loha Chor gang. Subsequently, law enforcement authorities conducted a raid on the premises.
Following a casual encounter, a man attempts to murder his female companion. Soon, his motives for revenge and the ultimate fate of both individuals begins to unravel.

Sahir moves to Mumbai with his family to pursue his dreams. However, he faces several challenges to establish himself as a poet and writer in the city of dreams.
Soon-to-wed live-in partners Nandita and Rahul face unexpected turmoil when Rahul's ex-girlfriend Suhana suddenly reaches out to him.

A single mother, living in a small village, takes care of her little daughter's educational expenses by doing tailoring work. One day, she receives a pension letter, for which she has to visit the Gramin bank. There, she encounters something unexpected.

A mid-thirties property broker in Lucknow named Sajan Tiwari engages in an illicit liaison, only to be discovered by his five-year-old son Bunty. Subsequently, Sajan becomes frantic in his attempts to prevent Bunty from divulging this information to his spouse Manju, resulting in a lighthearted depiction of provincial life, interpersonal bonds, and domestic affairs.
Upon receiving a call from a man in America about his ailing parents, a doctor visits their home. However, once there, she is shocked by what she sees.

On a fateful day, Parul hails a taxi to visit her boyfriend Ansh. Ansh, eagerly anticipating her arrival, is thrown into restlessness. However, their journey takes an unexpected turn when the taxi driver receives news of his daughter falling ill. Witnessing this, Parul's compassionate response sparks anger in Ansh. Yet, in the face of adversity, Parul's decision unfolds, offering inspiration to the youth.
A rural girl's aspirations for independence are threatened when an unexpected marriage proposal arrives, challenging her simple dreams of freedom.
A young boy comes across a beautiful girl when he secretly enters a prohibited area frequented by couples and men in general.
Dive into the chaotic world of stocks where dreams are traded like commodities and everyone is a self-proclaimed expert.
Karan expresses his deep love through poetry, contrasting sharply with Simran's belief that true affection must mirror the perfect romance of the movie 'Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge'.

SAANJH tells the story of Shyam and Sandhya, childhood friends who meet for the last time. Shyam loves Sandhya, but she sees him only as a friend. We surprisingly learn that Shyam is actually struggling with mental disorder, and Sandhya is nothing but just in his imagination. Despite the calm riverbank setting, Shyam's inner struggles are evident. As Shyam faces reality, he realizes he must accept things as they are, showing the power of love and understanding ourselves.
An impoverished vocalist named Avik faces financial hardships as he tries to provide for his family while attempting to win over his love, Shukla.

programs.showName: Once Upon A Time In Office
programs.description: A young woman faces unfair treatment from older male colleagues, causing discomfort. After seeking help without success, she ponders ways to address and overcome the challenging situation at work.
Siraj, a poor flute maker, resides in the forest of Pilibhit, known for its man-eating tigers. Soon, his poverty and the tragedies in his life threaten to break his values.
Five years after parting ways, Nimisha and Atish reunite at an awards gala. Despite appearing to have moved on, they soon realise they are living a lie and decide to honour an old pact.
Explore the story of a woman whose captivating beauty lures men into her world, much like a spider weaving an irresistible web.
A married couple, meeting in a café to finalise their divorce, is unexpectedly joined by a mutual friend. However, they begin to rethink their decision after the friend reminds them of a past event.
Criminals Ayan and Kabir kidnap a mob boss's daughter. However, the tables turn when their hostage, Nicole, manipulates the ransom and orchestrates a deadly plan to ensure there are no witnesses.
A young village man becomes fascinated with a social media influencer and seeks her out, only to be confronted with the startling contrast between her virtual and actual life.

A 24-year-old man, feeling the weight of societal expectations, decides to take an unconventional step in his search for intimacy. His choice leads him down an unexpected path, filled with awkward moments and conflicting emotions. What begins as a straightforward transaction evolves into a profound learning experience, guided by an unexpectedly wise companion.
Sita Ram Chaddha, a widower, longs for attention from his son and daughter-in-law who are busy with their own lives. Seeing his loneliness, Biba, his daughter, decides to help him out.
Sita Ram Chaddha, a widower, longs for attention from his son and daughter-in-law who are busy with their own lives. Seeing his loneliness, Biba, his daughter, decides to help him out.
Nikita and Neeraj share a long-standing acquaintance, yet she feels uncomfortable with Neeraj's physical contact. Adding to her dilemma, Aniket has recently proposed to her.

A couple navigates the ups and downs of their relationship, with him being shorter and her towering over him. From playful teasing by the maid to awkward encounters, his height becomes a source of humor and occasional frustration. However, amidst the laughs and challenges, her unwavering love reassures him that their bond transcends any physical differences. Join them on a delightful journey of love and laughter, where acceptance triumphs over insecurities.
A cab driver's quiet routine is shattered when she picks up an apparently innocuous passenger carrying a red suitcase. What starts off as a simple ride soon turns into a twisted journey.
A mother loves her child dearly, which gives the latter the strength and courage to overcome various obstacles and face fears.
When his daughter is killed by the terrorist he is chasing, Daanish, a policeman, vows revenge. He finds a confidante in Pandit, a grandmaster, who is also mourning the loss of his daughter.
Two brothers, who are aspiring filmmakers, are forced to use their mother's fund to make their film. However, disagreements arise when their mother does not approve the contents of the film.
Kartik and Ishita reconnect for a final chat, stirring up old emotions and unresolved issues. However, Uljhan delves into the complexities of closure.
In a small town near Delhi, two young boys from contrasting socioeconomic backgrounds happen to have a fateful encounter.

Chitra, a method actor known for her ability to deliver realistic performances, starts preparing for her next role. However, things take a dark turn when the intensity of her character and her desire to excel in her work cause her to lose touch with reality.
Rahul and Priya meet during a trip to Goa and fall in love with each other. However, their lives take a turn when Rahul learns that Priya is the sibling of Shiva, who had once tortured his sister.
A successful businessman decides to take a break from his mundane life and goes on a vacation. Furthermore, he happens to meet a stranger who transforms him.

The Struggle of an Actress in the Film Industry: A young woman faces difficulties when working with a demanding director who creates a stressful environment. She expresses her concerns to the producer, but he reacts angrily and uses harsh language toward her. Will the actress decide to find a way to work together or stand up for herself?
